components.name: ICS-VEX Reverse SBOM Builder
components.description: Reverse-builds a CycloneDX SBOM-CVE per ICS device from the CISA ICS-CERT advisory corpus.

component.name: Siemens SIMATIC RTLS Locating Manager
component.description: ICS/OT asset 'SIMATIC RTLS Locating Manager' by Siemens, reverse-built from CISA ICS-CERT advisory data.

externalReferences.comment: Source CISA ICS-CERT advisories: icsa-20-252-01, icsa-21-315-11, icsa-24-137-07, icsa-25-226-01, icsa-25-226-13

components.name: OpenSSL
components.description: TLS/SSL and general-purpose cryptography library. Handles the device's secure communication channels and certificate processing.

components.name: libcurl
components.description: HTTP/TLS client used for firmware-update downloads and cloud telemetry uploads.
